programmes.programName: Doctor of Management Science and Engineering
programmes.department: Department of Management Science and Engineering
programmes.evidence: Opened Beihang official programme page dated 2 June 2026 titles the full-time four-year doctorate Doctor of Management Science and Engineering. The named degree and official host department satisfy the title rule.
limitations: The page lists smart operations and logistics as research areas, not separate formal doctoral routes.

branches.conclusion: School of Economics and Management presents a current Doctor of Management Science and Engineering, hosted by the named department.
Other engineering-school PhD specifications and unit titles have not been exhaustively checked.

sources.note: Official current English doctoral programme title and structure.
Official host-department title and PhD provision.

limitations: Wider Beihang technical doctoral inventory remains incomplete.
Two reported OM List doctorates are discovery leads only.
